SYMPTOM: Prisma CLI in Docker runner kept loading old `prisma.config.ts` with `import 'dotenv/config'` even after fixing the file.
CAUSE: `next build` with `output: 'standalone'` copies ALL project files into `.next/standalone/`, including the OLD `prisma.config.ts`. Then `COPY --from=builder /app/.next/standalone ./` in the runner overwrites our fixed file with the bundled-in old version.
FIX: In Dockerfile runner stage, `COPY prisma.config.ts ./prisma.config.ts` AFTER the standalone copy line. Also `RUN npm install -g prisma` in runner stage for CLI access during migrations.
WHY: The standalone bundle is a self-contained snapshot — it captures the state of ALL files at build time including config files.
GOTCHA: `COPY . .` in builder stage runs before `npx prisma generate` — generate doesn't overwrite our config, but the standalone copy does.
